instruction: I accidentally closed the Properties panel and need it back. Please restore the Properties panel on the right side so I can edit slide properties.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=12, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to restore the Properties panel in LibreOffice Impress. The setup closes the Properties panel via View menu. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for 'Properties' panel element.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks for Properties panel visibility in accessibility tree
Metric logic is semantically correct: iterates panel elements and matches name attribute
Getter appropriately uses accessibility_tree to extract UI state
Incomplete coverage: instruction specifies panel should be 'on the right side' but evaluator only checks existence, not position
Unused namespace definitions in metric function suggest incomplete implementation
Expected parameter is empty dict and unused by metric function, though this is acceptable for this simple check
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying panel position (right side) by checking accessibility tree attributes for panel location/bounds
Remove unused namespace definitions from metric function to clean up code
Add robustness for potential localization: check if panel position/bounds indicate right-side placement
